name: molecular-interfaces
title: Molecular Interfaces
question: The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) frames a molecule not as a lump of state but as a typed interface exposing several physical channels -- chemical, electrostatic, mechanical, thermal -- through which molecules bind, react, and transmit force and heat. It even names the public databases (PDB, Reactome, ChEBI, GO) as "partial specifications of molecular interfaces and their types". This study asks the discriminating question one channel down: does that molecular interface hold SPATIALLY? Concretely -- do local molecular reactions plus differential diffusion (the CHEMICAL channel spatialized, i.e. Turing / reaction-diffusion patterning) turn a near-uniform seed into emergent spatial structure, and does a temperature field GRADE that structure (the THERMAL channel, an Arrhenius rate modulation) -- so that two of the interface's physical channels demonstrably COMPOSE over one shared spatial field? The causal control -- equal diffusion (Du = Dv), chemistry untouched -- differs in exactly one variable and isolates the diffusion-driven instability as the cause of structure, so the contrast between pattern and uniformity is the finding.
biological_summary:
The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) makes a molecule a typed interface: it exposes physical channels -- chemical fluxes, electrostatic fields, mechanical forces, thermal transfer -- and its identity is the shape of those channels, not a scalar concentration. A coarser, specification-stage, point-scale lumped realization made ONE molecule's four channels executable at a POINT (an F1Fo ATP synthase whose chemical/electrostatic/mechanical/thermal ports were wired as a typed draft and compiled). This study takes the CHEMICAL channel off the point and onto a 2D lattice, and adds the THERMAL channel on top of it, to ask whether a molecular interface's channels compose spatially. The chemical channel is realized as a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system on a 128x128 periodic grid: a local autocatalytic chemistry (U + 2V -> 3V, V -> P) coupled to DIFFERENTIAL diffusion (Dv < Du), the textbook route by which a near-uniform state becomes Turing-unstable and breaks into spots (turing1952). The update is explicit-Euler du/dt = Du*lap(u) - U*V^2 + F*(1-U), dv/dt = Dv*lap(v) + U*V^2 - (F+k)*V on the periodic 5-point Laplacian, canonical spot regime Du=0.16, Dv=0.08, F=0.037, k=0.06, dt=1.0 (CFL max(Du,Dv)*dt*4 = 0.64 < 1, guarded at construction). The thermal channel is a second, orthogonal port: when a temperature field is present the reaction term is scaled elementwise by the Arrhenius factor rate = exp(-Ea*(1/T - 1/Tref)) -- T above Tref speeds the chemistry, below slows it, and rate == 1 with no field, so the thermal channel is genuinely additive to the chemical one rather than replacing it. Realizing the paper's databases claim, honestly. The paper calls PDB/Reactome/ChEBI/GO "partial specifications of molecular interfaces and their types"; this study makes that concrete not as a resolved database lookup but as an ILLUSTRATIVE typed-port annotation over the Gray-Scott species and reactions. Read U as a ChEBI-style substrate type, V as an activator/inhibitor species, P as the product sink, and U + 2V -> 3V as a Reactome-style autocatalytic reaction record (placeholder identifiers, e.g. CHEBI:/CHEBI:/CHEBI:

and REACT:) -- a concrete gesture at what it would mean for a database entry to TYPE a molecular interface, not a claim that these toy species resolve to real PDB structures or Reactome pathway fragments. A genuine Reactome-fragment mapping, or a live database fetch that types the ports against real entries, is a named deferral, not a result here. Measured this build. The CHEMICAL channel patterns: from the near-uniform seed the inhibitor field's spatial variance v_var rises from ~0.0011 toward ~0.0119 by 8000 internal steps and the field resolves into ~12 connected v-domains (patterned == 1.0). The equal-diffusion causal control (Du = Dv = 0.12, chemistry identical) stays UNIFORM -- v_var ~= 0 (patterned == 0.0) -- so the structure is caused by the diffusion asymmetry (the Turing instability), not by the chemistry alone: removing only the differential diffusion removes the pattern. The THERMAL channel GRADES that pattern rather than destroying it: a raised uniform temperature field (Ea=0.15, Tref=1.0, T=1.2) coarsens the flagship from ~12 domains to ~2 and lowers v_var from ~0.0119 to ~0.0096 while staying comfortably patterned -- a real second modality modulating the first, not a chemistry collapse. (An earlier, hotter setting Ea=1.0/T=1.5 was found to OVERSHOOT -- the reaction runs away and collapses the pattern to near-uniform -- and was retuned to the milder graded setting; the overshoot is pinned as a direct-physics assertion so "graded, not collapsed" is tested against its own failure mode.) Because the physics has no RNG, the multi-seed check re-draws the near-uniform seed for seeds 1-5 and reports a RANGE: v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] -- the pattern forms for every seed, stated as a band rather than a single golden value. Honest scope -- the four-modality finding, stated plainly. This study realizes TWO of the molecular interface's four physical channels spatially: the CHEMICAL channel (reaction-diffusion / Turing patterning) and the THERMAL channel (Arrhenius rate modulation grading it). The ELECTROSTATIC and MECHANICAL channels are the named gap -- no charge field, no force or tension, is exposed or measured here (owned in investigation.yaml's what_this_does_not_demonstrate, as a named deferral). And this is a TOY reaction-diffusion demonstration: emergent spatial structure from a minimal autocatalytic chemistry with tuned, uncalibrated constants, NOT real molecular structure or conformation (nothing at PDB resolution), NOT a fitted reaction network, NOT a resolved database mapping. What is demonstrated is that a molecular interface's chemical and thermal channels COMPOSE spatially over one shared field; what is not is the other two channels, real molecular structure, and a live database type system.
claim: The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) holds spatially for two of its four physical channels. The CHEMICAL channel, realized as a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system (local autocatalysis U + 2V -> 3V plus differential diffusion Dv < Du), turns a near-uniform seed into an emergent Turing spot pattern: v_var rises from ~0.0011 to ~0.0119 with ~12 connected domains (patterned == 1.0). The equal-diffusion causal control (Du = Dv = 0.12, chemistry unchanged -- the single differing variable) stays UNIFORM (v_var ~= 0, patterned == 0.0), so the pattern is CAUSED by the diffusion-driven instability, not the chemistry alone. The THERMAL channel -- a raised temperature field scaling the reaction by the Arrhenius factor exp(-Ea*(1/T - 1/Tref)) -- GRADES the pattern (Ea=0.15, T=1.2: ~12 domains -> ~2, v_var ~0.0119 -> ~0.0096) while staying patterned: a real second modality composing over the same field, not a collapse. Multi-seed (seeds 1-5, physics is deterministic so the seed is re-drawn into the initial field): v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] -- reported as a range. The honest boundaries are findings, not caveats: the ELECTROSTATIC and MECHANICAL channels are the named four-modality gap; the databases claim (PDB/Reactome/ChEBI/GO as partial specifications of molecular-interface types) is realized as an ILLUSTRATIVE typed-port annotation over the Gray-Scott species, not a resolved mapping; and this is a toy reaction-diffusion demonstration, not real molecular structure or conformation.
key_assumptions: The interface tested here is the paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7): a molecule as a typed interface exposing physical channels (chemical, electrostatic, mechanical, thermal). This study realizes the CHEMICAL channel spatially as Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion (local autocatalysis U + 2V -> 3V, V -> P plus differential diffusion Dv < Du -- Turing patterning; turing1952) and the THERMAL channel as an Arrhenius elementwise rate modulation exp(-Ea*(1/T - 1/Tref)) on the reaction term. The ELECTROSTATIC and MECHANICAL channels are NOT realized -- they are the named four-modality gap, not demonstrated here.

The databases hook is ILLUSTRATIVE typed-port annotation, not a resolved mapping. The paper names PDB/Reactome/ChEBI/GO as "partial specifications of molecular interfaces and their types"; here that is gestured at by TYPING the Gray-Scott species and reaction with placeholder database-style identifiers (U/V/P as ChEBI-style substrate/activator/product types, U + 2V -> 3V as a Reactome-style autocatalytic reaction record). This is a concrete gesture at what typing a molecular interface against a database would mean -- NOT a claim that these toy species resolve to real PDB structures, Reactome pathway fragments, or ChEBI/GO entries. A real Reactome-fragment mapping / live database fetch is a deferral.

The pattern is CAUSED by the diffusion-driven (Turing) instability, and this is proven by a single-variable causal control, not assumed. The flagship (Du=0.16, Dv=0.08) and the equal-diffusion control (Du=Dv=0.12) share identical chemistry (F, k), identical seed, identical wiring and step count; the ONLY difference is whether diffusion is differential. Removing the asymmetry removes the pattern (v_var ~= 0, exactly 0.0 in the control), isolating differential diffusion -- not the reaction alone -- as the cause of spatial structure.

The thermal channel is genuinely ADDITIVE, not a re-parameterization of the chemical one. The reaction term is scaled by rate = exp(-Ea*(1/T - 1/Tref)); with NO temperature field present rate == 1 everywhere and the process is pure chemistry, byte-identical to the chemical-only flagship. The thermal composite differs from the flagship in exactly the Arrhenius parameters and the presence of a raised temperature field -- Du/Dv/F/k/dt/steps_per_tick are held equal (asserted in tests/test_molecular_regime.py), so the coarsening is attributable to temperature, not to a changed chemistry or diffusion regime.

The parameters are tuned demonstration values, not fitted. The canonical spot regime (Du=0.16, Dv=0.08, F=0.037, k=0.06, dt=1.0) sits in the classic Gray-Scott spot window and comfortably inside the explicit reaction-diffusion CFL limit (max(Du,Dv)*dt*4 = 0.64 < 1; the process raises on an unstable config rather than drifting silently to NaN). The thermal setting (Ea=0.15, T=1.2) was chosen to GRADE rather than collapse: a hotter Ea=1.0/T=1.5 was found to overshoot into near-uniform collapse and was retuned. No literature acceptance band is claimed -- this is a demonstration primitive of the molecular interface's chemical and thermal channels made spatial, not a model of a specific molecule or medium.

The physics is DETERMINISTIC -- it has no RNG. The GrayScott process accepts a seed config key but it is currently inert (documented in meta_modelers_guide/molecular/gray_scott.py), so the composites bake a static seed_uv(seed=1) draw into fields.u/fields.v at build time. The multi-seed test therefore re-draws the INITIAL near-uniform field with seed_uv(seed=s) for s in 1-5 (everything else held fixed) and reports the resulting band -- v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] -- as genuine sensitivity of the emergent pattern to the nucleation-patch placement, not as a per-tick stochastic process.

behavior_tests.description: The mechanism of the thermal grading, made explicit: the raised temperature field coarsens the pattern to markedly fewer, larger domains than the no-temperature flagship at the same step count (~12 -> ~2), the direct signature of the thermal channel acting on the chemical one.

conclusion:
## Claims

- The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) chemical channel holds as a 2D spatial mechanism: a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system (autocatalysis U + 2V -> 3V plus differential diffusion Dv < Du) turns a near-uniform seed into an emergent Turing spot pattern (v_var ~0.0011 -> ~0.0119, ~12 domains, patterned == 1.0), while the single-variable equal-diffusion causal control (Du = Dv = 0.12) stays UNIFORM (v_var ~= 0, patterned == 0.0). Removing only the diffusion asymmetry removes the pattern.

- The thermal channel composes with the chemical one: a raised temperature field Arrhenius-scaling the reaction (Ea=0.15, T=1.2) GRADES the pattern (~12 -> ~2 domains, v_var ~0.0119 -> ~0.0096) while staying patterned -- a real second modality, not a collapse. Two of the molecular interface's four channels demonstrably compose spatially.

## Evidence

- **PATTERN-FORMS** -- patterned == 1.0, v_var ~0.0011 -> ~0.0119 over 8000 steps

- **PATTERN-HAS-MULTIPLE-DOMAINS** -- n_domains ~= 12 (multi-seed band [8, 12])

- **EQUAL-DIFFUSION-CONTROL-UNIFORM** -- Du=Dv=0.12: patterned == 0.0, v_var ~= 0 (single-variable causal control)

- **THERMAL-CHANNEL-STILL-PATTERNS** -- thermal patterned == 1.0, v_var ~= 0.0096 (graded, not collapsed)

- **THERMAL-CHANNEL-COARSENS** -- n_domains ~12 -> ~2 under the raised temperature field

- **PATTERN-IS-MULTISEED-ROBUST** -- v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] across seeds 1-5

## Limitations

- Two of the molecular interface's four physical channels are realized spatially (chemical + thermal); the ELECTROSTATIC and MECHANICAL channels are the named four-modality gap -- no charge field, no force or tension, is exposed or measured. Owned in investigation.yaml as a named deferral.

- This is a toy reaction-diffusion demonstration with tuned, uncalibrated constants -- emergent spatial structure from a minimal autocatalytic chemistry, NOT real molecular structure or conformation (nothing at PDB resolution), not a fitted reaction network.

- The databases claim (PDB/Reactome/ChEBI/GO as partial specifications of molecular-interface types) is realized as an ILLUSTRATIVE typed-port annotation over the Gray-Scott species (U/V/P and the autocatalytic reaction given placeholder database-style identifiers), NOT a resolved mapping. A real Reactome-fragment mapping / live database fetch is deferred.

- The physics is deterministic (no RNG); the multi-seed range reflects sensitivity of the emergent pattern to the initial nucleation-patch placement, re-drawn into the initial field, not a per-tick stochastic process.

## Next steps

- The electrostatic and mechanical channels made spatial (a charge field driving electromigration; a mechanical force/tension coupling), so more than two of the molecular interface's four channels compose on one field.

- A real Reactome-fragment mapping / live database fetch that TYPES the Gray-Scott ports against actual ChEBI/Reactome entries, upgrading the illustrative typed-port annotation to a resolved database mapping.

Spatializing the electrical and mechanical channels, and realizing a named molecular machine rather than a generic reaction-diffusion chemistry, remain open.
The specialized enzymatic subports (substrate, cofactor, catalyst, product) are not addressed; only the top-level chemical and thermal physical channels are realized spatially.
falsifiability: Overturned if the flagship fails to pattern within the 8000-step window (v_var stays near 0 or patterned != 1.0 -- differential diffusion not destabilizing the seed), if the equal-diffusion control DOES pattern (v_var rising with Du = Dv -- the structure not actually caused by the diffusion asymmetry), or if the thermal run collapses instead of grading (v_var below the pattern floor -- the Arrhenius rate overshooting, as the retired Ea=1.0/T=1.5 setting did) or fails to coarsen the pattern.

experiment: Run three Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion composites to completion through the process-bigraph engine directly from their JSON specs: molecular-turing-pattern (GrayScott, a 128x128 near-uniform seed under the canonical differential-diffusion spot regime Du=0.16/Dv=0.08, 8000 internal steps), molecular-equal-diffusion-control (the single-variable causal control, Du=Dv=0.12, identical chemistry and seed), and molecular-thermal-graded (identical chemistry/diffusion/seed plus a raised uniform temperature field T=1.2 Arrhenius-scaling the reaction, Ea=0.15). Measure whether the flagship patterns (v_var above the floor, patterned == 1.0, more than one domain) while the equal-diffusion control stays uniform (v_var ~= 0), and whether the thermal channel grades the pattern (coarser -- fewer domains, lower but still-patterned v_var) rather than collapsing it; re-draw the initial field for seeds 1-5 and report v_var / n_domains as a range.
result: The chemical channel patterns -- the near-uniform Gray-Scott seed destabilizes under differential diffusion into an emergent Turing spot pattern (v_var ~0.0011 -> ~0.0119, ~12 domains, patterned == 1.0) -- while the single-variable equal-diffusion causal control (Du=Dv=0.12) stays uniform (v_var ~= 0, patterned == 0.0), realizing the paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) chemical channel as a spatial mechanism and isolating differential diffusion as the cause. The thermal channel composes over the same field -- a raised temperature field (Ea=0.15, T=1.2) grades the pattern (~12 -> ~2 domains, v_var ~0.0119 -> ~0.0096) while staying patterned, a real second modality, not a collapse. The honest boundaries are reported as findings -- the electrostatic and mechanical channels are the named four-modality gap, this is a toy reaction-diffusion demonstration and not real molecular structure, and the databases claim is realized as illustrative typed-port annotation over the Gray-Scott species rather than a resolved mapping. Multi-seed: v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] across seeds 1-5, reported as a range.
